### Step 3: Calculate Sections per Line

Each intersection on a line divides it into one more segment. So for any line intersected **k** times, it is divided into **k + 1** sections.

| Line     | Intersections | Sections (k + 1) |

| Green    | 1             | 2                |

Now summing up all the sections:

$$
3 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 13
$$

---

### Final Answer

$$
\boxed{13}
